scope: Three clean ACKs grow the per-peer window; threshold+1 admission boundary.
A retried third ACK grows the window before resetting the accumulator.
A retried second ACK resets partial progress without growing the window.
DACK releases NSDP immediately, retaining HOP capacity for the ordinary 20-second hold.
A DACK after the maximum two retries holds capacity for 40 seconds.
Natural final retry expiration lowers threshold once and never below zero.
Window ceiling and global capacity remain separate from per-peer capacity.
Cumulative newest-first ACK/DACK processing, overlap precedence and duplicate idempotence.
Reduced ordered feedback motif from native seed 130 startup; times and surrounding traffic are controlled.
